products.name: Intravenous (IV) Cannula Set (With Wings & Port)
products.whatItDoes: Provides secure, comfortable, and reliable venous access for the rapid delivery of medications and fluids.
whyItsSafe: Manufactured by La-Med Healthcare Pvt. Ltd. under strict ISO guidelines.
Integrated port allows for needle-free secondary medication administration.
Flexible wings ensure secure skin fixation, reducing patient trauma.
products.specs: Available Specs (Gauges): G14, G16, G17, G18, G20, G22, G24, G26

products.name: Sterile Blood Transfusion Set (With AirVent)
products.whatItDoes: Ensures the safe, controlled, and sterile delivery of blood and blood components to the patient.
whyItsSafe: Features a built-in AirVent to maintain a steady, uninterrupted flow rate.
Designed with an advanced filtration chamber to prevent micro-clots and debris.
Kink-resistant medical-grade tubing guarantees reliable delivery during emergencies.
products.specs: Drip chamber volume: 20 drops/ml | Filter mesh: 200 microns

products.name: Carboplatin Injection (150mg/15ml & 450mg/45ml)
products.whatItDoes: Essential platinum-based chemotherapy agent for ovarian, lung, and head/neck carcinoma treatment.
whyItsSafe: Sourced directly from audited oncology parenteral manufacturing units.
Shipped in thermal-insulated containers with digital continuous temperature tracking.
Accompanied by Certificate of Analysis (CoA) and batch test release data.
products.specs: Storage: 2°C to 8°C | Vials per box: 10 Vials | FDA CSP Ready

products.name: High-Pressure Seamless Steel Medical Gas Cylinder (40L Oxygen)
products.whatItDoes: Provides high-purity medical oxygen storage for ICU respirators, emergency crash carts, and surgical suites.
whyItsSafe: Constructed from high-grade 34CrMo4 alloy steel tested to 200 bar operating pressure.
Fitted with Pin-Index / DIN standard chrome-plated brass valves for leak-free sealing.
Includes individual hydrostatic test certificates and serial batch stamping.
products.specs: Water capacity: 40 Liters | Working Pressure: 150-200 Bar | Valve: CGA 540 / BS 341

products.name: Cuffed Endotracheal Airway Tube Set (Sterile)
products.whatItDoes: Maintains open airway and ventilation during general anesthesia and critical care intubation.
whyItsSafe: High-volume, low-pressure cuff reduces tracheal wall mucosal trauma.
Radio-opaque line along full tube length enables accurate X-ray position check.
Smooth Murphy eye protects against accidental airway occlusion.
products.specs: Sizes: ID 3.0mm to 9.0mm (0.5mm increments) | Standard 15mm connector

products.name: Multi-Parameter Patient Monitor (ECG, SpO2, NIBP, Temp)
products.whatItDoes: Continuously tracks a patient's vital signs — heart rhythm, oxygen saturation, blood pressure, and temperature — in ICU, ER, and general ward settings.
whyItsSafe: 12.1-inch color touchscreen with configurable alarm thresholds for early deterioration alerts.
Built-in rechargeable battery provides up to 4 hours of monitoring during patient transport.
Calibrated against international IEC 60601-1 medical electrical safety standards.
products.specs: Display: 12.1" TFT | Battery backup: 4 hrs | Modules: ECG, SpO2, NIBP, Temp, Resp

products.name: Electric ICU Hospital Bed (5-Function)
products.whatItDoes: Provides adjustable, motorized positioning for critical and long-term care patients, reducing pressure injuries and easing nursing care.
whyItsSafe: Reinforced steel frame rated for patients up to 185kg with full side-rail safety enclosure.
Electric back, knee, and height adjustment reduces manual handling injury risk for staff.
X-ray translucent panel allows imaging without patient transfer.
products.specs: Weight capacity: 185kg | Functions: Back, Knee, Height, Trendelenburg, Reverse-Trendelenburg

products.name: AAMI Level 3 Surgical Isolation Gown (Sterile, Disposable)
products.whatItDoes: Protects clinical staff from fluid exposure during surgical and moderate-risk patient care procedures.
whyItsSafe: Reinforced sleeve and torso panels tested to AAMI PB70 Level 3 fluid barrier standard.
Knit cuffs and rear-tie closure ensure a secure, contamination-free fit.
Individually packed and gamma-sterilized for single-use reliability.
products.specs: Sizes: S to XXL | Material: SMS Non-woven, 45gsm | Sterility: Gamma-irradiated

products.name: Portable Point-of-Care Ultrasound Scanner
products.whatItDoes: Delivers real-time diagnostic imaging at the bedside for emergency, obstetric, and critical care assessment.
whyItsSafe: Wireless probe with 5-hour battery life eliminates cable hazards in busy wards.
Multi-frequency transducer supports abdominal, cardiac, and vascular scanning in one device.
Encrypted image storage supports patient data protection compliance.
products.specs: Probe: Wireless multi-frequency | Battery: 5 hrs | Display: 12" HD touchscreen

products.name: Class B Vacuum Autoclave Sterilizer (23L)
products.whatItDoes: Sterilizes surgical instruments, porous loads, and hollow devices using pre-vacuum steam cycles for complete microbial elimination.
whyItsSafe: Fractionated pre-vacuum cycle penetrates wrapped and hollow instruments fully, per Class B standard.
Automated cycle logging with printable batch records supports full sterilization traceability.
Built-in safety interlocks prevent door opening during active pressurized cycles.
products.specs: Chamber volume: 23L | Cycle types: Class B, Prion, Quick | Max temp: 134°C

products.name: Advanced Silver Foam Wound Dressing
products.whatItDoes: Manages moderate to heavily exuding wounds while releasing ionic silver to reduce bacterial bioburden and support faster healing.
whyItsSafe: Sustained silver release provides antimicrobial protection for up to 7 days per application.
Highly absorbent foam layer locks in exudate, minimizing maceration of surrounding skin.
Non-adherent wound contact layer allows atraumatic dressing changes.
products.specs: Sizes: 10x10cm, 15x15cm, 20x20cm | Wear time: Up to 7 days
